text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has injured herself, so I
take her
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for looking out for me,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... it's not so bad. I think I can keep
going.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm all patched up now, so let's keep
going a bit
longer.
...What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm all patched up now, so let's keep
going a bit
longer.
...What do you say?
choice_data_list: 気をつけながら頑張ってみるか？
気をつけながら頑張ってみる？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But it barely even hurts. As long as I'm
careful,
there shouldn't any problem...
choice_data_list: 気をつけながら頑張ってみるか？
気をつけながら頑張ってみる？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. Even a small injury
can lead to
something much worse.
choice_data_list: 悪化しないうちにやめておこう

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'll go home and take it easy
for today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems disappointed after being so
motivated,
but she obediently heads
back to her dorm room
to rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'd like to finish everything we have
planned
for the day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Respecting her wishes, I decide to
continue
training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: ……やっぱり痛むんじゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually... It seems that I may have

underestimated how bad it is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, we both agree to cut training
short so
Satono Diamond can rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whew! That's the last of it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: ケガしたところは大丈夫か？
ケガしたところは大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Light exercise doesn't seem to be a
problem!
Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was concerned, but she doesn't seem
to be in
any pain. It appears it really was
a minor injury.
